conventions.units: metres, kilograms, square metres; mm for marking sizes
conventions.hex: sRGB #RRGGBB; 'stripes:#a,#b,...' means sail panel bands in that order from foot to head; 'multi' means pick a multi-colour panel pattern; 'match ...' references another field; null means leave base material
conventions.weights: relative within a list; normalise before sampling
conventions.intensity: 0..1 range [min,max] per wear profile; seed per boat, sample a profile from wear.profile_weights, then sample each zone uniformly in its range
